# Open Model Family Tree

> The ancestry of every model on the Hugging Face Hub, rebuilt nightly from declared base_model metadata. Generated 2026-11-23 from the 2026-11-23 Hub dump.

- 3,258,941 models tracked, 942,840 declare a base model, 976,261 parent links, 93,807 models have descendants.
- Counts are unique descendants (finetunes, adapters, quantizations, merges), each counted once.
